description: Trinkwasserschutzgebiete (WSG) (Umrisse) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by umweltkarten-niedersachsen.de. External boundaries of the water protection areas (WSG).A drinking water protection area (WSG) is a catchment area of drinking water abstraction points of the public water supply established by regulation in accordance with Section 51(1) of the Water Management Act (WHG) in conjunction with Section 91 of the Lower Saxony Water Act (NWG) in order ... Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water protection areas (WSG) (outlines)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include INSPIRE, opendata. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
